message.reasoning_content: We need to classify relation between two manifestations. Both are speeches by same actor (blinded). They are both opening remarks at public hearings, different topics: one about Estatuto do Povo Cigano (Roma people statute), the other about inclusion of care economy in GDP. They are different propositions. Both have determinable stance? The speaker is presiding, expressing support for the topics? In first, she supports the statute, says "contem conosco", "estamos juntos". In second, she seems more cautious, questioning whether care economy deserves more visibility, says "questionar se realmente precisamos dar ainda mais visibilidade", "avaliar com cautela se devemos transformar isso... em política pública". So stance is not clearly favor or against a specific proposition; she is opening a debate. But both are not responding to same specific proposition. So they are incomparable because different propositions. Both have determinable stance? They have stance towards their respective topics (supportive vs cautious). But the categories: INCOMPARABLE: "as duas manifestações têm posição determinável, mas não respondem à mesma proposição específica." That fits. So answer INCOMPARABLE. Provide reasoning.
